login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue to SAMARTH AI.
login.locked: Too many unsuccessful attempts. You can try again in {{time}}.
login.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet. We can send you a new verification link.
login.passwordResetNotice: Your password was updated. Log in with your new password.

reactivated.title: Account restored
reactivated.body: Welcome back. Your account is active again and any scheduled deletion has been cancelled.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Build your competency profile in a few minutes.
signup.consentLabel: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>
signup.passwordHelp: Spaces and any language are fine. Longer phrases are stronger.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password you have not used before.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Select the button below to confirm your email address.

already.title: Email already verified
already.body: Your email address is already confirmed. You can continue to your dashboard.

acceptInvite.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvite.subtitle: Set your name and password to join SAMARTH AI.

sso.title: Signing you in
sso.stubTitle: Single sign-on is a prototype stub
sso.stubBody: Government single sign-on is planned but not connected in this prototype. No sign-in happens on this page and no information is sent anywhere.
sso.stubNote: Use your email and password, or Google sign-in, on the log in page instead.

name: Full name
consent: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
cookiesDisabled: Cookies are turned off. SAMARTH AI needs cookies to keep you signed in.

verifySent.title: Check your inbox
verifySent.body: If an account can be created with {{email}}, we sent a verification link. It expires in 24 hours.
verifySent.hint: Cannot find it? Check your spam folder.
verifySent.changeHint: Made a typo? Go back and create the account with the right address.

verifyInvalid.title: Link expired or already used
verifyInvalid.body: This verification link is no longer valid. Request a new one. If you already verified, just sign in.

forgotSent.title: Reset link sent
forgotSent.body: If an account exists for that email, we sent a reset link. It is valid for 30 minutes and works once.

resetInvalid.title: Reset link invalid
resetInvalid.body: This reset link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.

resetSuccess.title: Password updated
resetSuccess.body: Your password was changed and all other sessions were signed out. Log in with your new password.

inviteInvalid.title: Invitation not valid
inviteInvalid.body: This invitation is expired, revoked or already used. Ask your administrator to send a new one.

mustChange.title: Change your password
mustChange.body: This account was set up with a temporary password. Choose a new one before you continue.
mustChange.notice: Changing your password signs you out of all your other devices.

success.title: Password changed
success.body: Your new password is active and your other devices were signed out.

start.title: Get started with SAMARTH AI
start.subtitle: Choose how you want to begin.
start.learnerTitle: I am an official or learner
start.learnerBody: Create your account and build your competency profile.
start.inviteBody: Open the invitation link from your email to set your password. Trainer and admin accounts are created by an administrator.

locked.unknown: Please wait a little while before trying again, or reset your password now.
locked.unlockedBody: The temporary lock has ended. Try signing in again.

deactivated.intro: Enter your password to reactivate your account.
deactivated.googleNote: If you only ever signed in with Google, contact support to reactivate your account.

layout.quote: Every level you see is backed by evidence and a formula you can inspect. People can always override it.

passwordHint.title: Your password needs
passwordHint.bytesOver_one: {{count}} byte over the limit. Letters outside basic English use more than one byte each.
passwordHint.bytesOver_other: {{count}} bytes over the limit. Letters outside basic English use more than one byte each.

googleStatus.blocked: Google sign-in could not load. A browser setting or extension may be blocking it. You can still use your email and password.
googleStatus.failed: Google sign-in was cancelled or did not complete. Please try again.

resend.sent: If the address is pending verification, we sent a new link.

requestLink.intro: Enter your email and we will send a new verification link if the address is waiting to be verified.
requestLink.sent: If the address is pending verification, we sent a new link.

summary.title_one: There is 1 problem with your entry
summary.title_other: There are {{count}} problems with your entry

confirmEmailChange.title: Confirm your new email
confirmEmailChange.subtitle: Select the button below to make this your SAMARTH AI email address.

done.title: Email address updated
done.body: Your new email address is confirmed. Use it the next time you log in. We sent a notice to your previous address with a link to undo this for 24 hours.

invalid.title: Link expired or already used
invalid.body: This email-change link is not valid any more. Start the change again from your security settings.

undoEmailChange.title: Undo email change
undoEmailChange.subtitle: Select the button below to cancel the change and keep your previous email address. For safety, every device is logged out.

done.title: Email change undone
done.body: Your previous email address is active again and every device was logged out. Log in, and consider changing your password.

invalid.title: Link expired or already used
invalid.body: This undo link is not valid any more. If you did not change your email, log in and change your password now.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your name, language, time zone and profile photo.

details.heading: Your details
details.description: Your email address is changed from Security. Your role is set by an administrator.
details.name: Full name
details.timezoneHelp: Dates and times are shown in this time zone. The list comes from your browser.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.

avatar.heading: Profile photo
avatar.description: Shown next to your name across SAMARTH AI. Without a photo, your initials are shown.
avatar.limits: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Camera and location details are removed when the photo is saved. The number of uploads per day is limited.
avatar.previewAlt: Preview of the new profile photo
avatar.previewNote: This is a preview. It is not saved until you select Save photo.
avatar.cancelled: Upload cancelled. Your photo is unchanged.

removeConfirm.title: Remove your photo?
removeConfirm.body: Your initials will be shown instead. You can upload a new photo at any time.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Control how you log in and keep your account safe.

reauth.googleHelp: Your account logs in with Google. Confirm it is you with that Google account.
reauth.googleRequired: Confirm with Google before you continue.
reauth.googleUnavailable: Google confirmation is not available here, so this change cannot be made.

password.heading: Password
password.description: Changing your password logs you out of your other devices.
password.descriptionSet: Your account logs in with Google. Add a password to log in with your email as well. Your other devices will be logged out.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were logged out.
password.set: Password set. Your other devices were logged out.

email.heading: Email address
email.description: Your email changes only after you confirm the new address. We also warn your current address.
email.sent: If {{email}} can be used, we sent a confirmation link to it. Your email changes only after you open that link. We also sent a notice, with a link to undo the change for 24 hours, to your current address.

google.heading: Google sign-in
google.description: Log in with your Google account as well as, or instead of, a password.
google.linkHelp: Choose the Google account that uses {{email}}. A Google account with a different email would log you in to a different account.
google.linkedNow: Google is now linked to your account.
google.switched: That Google account belongs to a different SAMARTH AI account, so you are now logged in as that account. Log out and log in again to return to yours.
google.onlyMethod: Google is your only way to log in. Add a password first, then you can unlink Google.
google.unlinkBody: You will log in with your email and password only. Confirm with the linked Google account to continue.

logoutAll.heading: Log out of all devices
logoutAll.description: Ends your session on this device and on every other one. Use it if you lost a device or think someone else has access.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.description: Schedules your account for deletion. You have 30 days to change your mind by logging in again.
delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: You will be logged out of every device now. If you log in within 30 days, the deletion is cancelled. After that your personal data is anonymised and cannot be restored.
delete.adminNote: If you are the last active administrator, deletion is refused until another administrator exists.
delete.scheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion. Log in before {{date}} to cancel.
delete.scheduledNoDate: Your account is scheduled for deletion. Log in within 30 days to cancel.

sessions.title: Devices and sessions
sessions.subtitle: Where you are logged in. Log out any device you do not recognise.
sessions.listLabel: Devices where you are logged in
sessions.revokeBody: {{device}} will be logged out. Whoever is using it will need to log in again.
sessions.othersBody: Every device except this one will be logged out.
sessions.limit: You can be logged in on up to 10 devices. Logging in on an 11th logs out the least recently used one.
sessions.emptyBody: Your device list is empty. Reload the page to check again.
